title: Georgica
summary: Georgica is an East Hampton placename associated with the farming district between East Hampton village and Wainscott and with Georgica Pond. Tooker traces the name through seventeenth-century records and local tradition.
address_label: Georgica Pond area, East Hampton, NY
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Georgica, Georgika, george cake, Jorgke, Georgeke, Georgekea, Jorgake, Georgicay, and Georgake. the meaning has not been ascertained and notes that it may be a corruption of the English name George, though local tradition associated the name with an Indigenous person who lived on the neck.

Why Place Names Matter

“The land provided the people with all that was needed to exist. It contained a memory of activities that ensured life and survival. This is embedded with the names of the many landmarks.”

— Bruce Cutknife, Language (2018), Article paragraph 12
land_loss_content: Georgica shows how local memory, Native presence, town boundaries, and whaling records became layered into one place name. The uncertain origin should remain visible rather than being forced into a false certainty.
whereintheworld_content: Tooker associates the name with the East Hampton district around modern Georgica Pond. Its exact historic extent remains uncertain.
